entradas.text: "Very interesting."
"Each Sordish citizen wants to contribute and work for their country. There is no need for such programs, the only necessity is opportunity."
"Just kidding. We have too many problems to solve here at home before we can think of entering the space race."
entradas.menu: "Just kidding. We have too many problems to solve here at home before we can think of entering the space race."

entradas.text: "Mr. President, just prior to tonight's debate your press office signaled there could be grander plans in store for your second term. Is that correct?"
"I'm happy some of our parties' so-called radical ideas are beginning to filter into the political mainstream."
"Very well."
"Absolutely."
entradas.menu: "Absolutely."

entradas.text: "We have an alliance. Aren't you supposed to be on my side?"
entradas.menu: "We have an alliance. Aren't you supposed to be on my side?"

entradas.text: "Well, you didn't run this by me."
"Laugh all you want. I'm going to make it happen."
entradas.menu: "Laugh all you want. I'm going to make it happen."

entradas.text: "This has been a goal of the NFP for some time now. But Anton Rayne cannot be trusted with his finger on the nuclear button."
"I've been pushing to include this in the next PFJP platform as well, but it's a hard sell with voters."
"Citizens will still work. My plan will only ensure nobody has to go homeless."
entradas.menu: "Citizens will still work. My plan will only ensure nobody has to go homeless."

entradas.text: "As your alliance partner, I pledge the NFP will also strive to enhance our nuclear capabilities."
"Sordland must develop a nuclear arsenal."
entradas.menu: "Sordland must develop a nuclear arsenal."

entradas.text: "We will grant a basic living wage to every man and woman in Sordland. Unemployed or otherwise."
entradas.menu: "We will grant a basic living wage to every man and woman in Sordland. Unemployed or otherwise."

entradas.text: "I want Sordland to put a man on the moon."
entradas.menu: "I want Sordland to put a man on the moon."

entradas.text: "You're mad. Sordish citizens want to work for their money. Handouts will only make them soft."
"I agree, but you've already proven yourself incapable of managing basic infrastructure projects."
"You're both mad. Disincentivizing work will crater this country's economy."
"There are so many problems still to be solved in Sordland. Space is just a flashy distraction."
"I agree with this plan in theory, but it would bankrupt our country in an instant."
The other candidates burst out laughing.
"I'm serious. Sordland is going into space."
entradas.menu: "I'm serious. Sordland is going into space."

entradas.text: The candidates around me gasped -- except Mansoun and Denis, who looked pleased.
The candidates around me gasped -- except for Remus, who looked intrigued.
The candidates around me gasped -- except for Kesaro, who looked faintly intrigued.
"You're insane. If we even attempt this, it's only a matter of time before Sordland becomes a crater."
"Perhaps, but you've already proven yourself incapable of managing basic infrastructure projects."

"I guess the USP has gotten it's hands on our new manifesto. In the new age nuclear power plays an important role. We need to position Sords as the dominant power in the region and our party is committed to such ends."
"You couldn't even open a highway on time, and now you're talking about building rockets?"
"You're insane. If we even attempt this, it's only a matter of time before Sordland becomes a crater."
"You couldn't even open a railway on time, and now you're talking about building rockets?"
"No, that release was sent out in error. I'm keeping my plans modest."
entradas.menu: "No, that release was sent out in error. I'm keeping my plans modest."

entradas.text: "Would you like to tell us what those are?"
"You'll find out once I get re-elected."
entradas.menu: "You'll find out once I get re-elected."

entradas.text: "There are so many problems still to be solved in Sordland. Space is just a flashy distraction."
"With nuclear war an increasing possibility, survival on other planets is something we must consider."
entradas.menu: "With nuclear war an increasing possibility, survival on other planets is something we must consider."

entradas.text: "If we want to be taken seriously by the superpowers, this is the only way."
entradas.menu: "If we want to be taken seriously by the superpowers, this is the only way."

entradas.text: "A space program would create thousands of jobs while boosting our national morale."
entradas.menu: "A space program would create thousands of jobs while boosting our national morale."

entradas.text: "You're insane. If we even attempt this, it's only a matter of time before Sordland becomes a crater."
The candidates around me gasped -- except for Lileas, who smiled.
"This was a longtime ambition of Tarquin Soll. However, Anton Rayne cannot be trusted to fulfill it."
"Only via mutually assured destruction can we achieve peace with our enemies."
entradas.menu: "Only via mutually assured destruction can we achieve peace with our enemies."

entradas.text: "A nuclear program would create thousands of jobs and boost national morale."
entradas.menu: "A nuclear program would create thousands of jobs and boost national morale."

entradas.text: The candidates around me gasped -- except Denis, who raised an eyebrow.
"If you think that kind of empty promise will win over my voters, you're dead wrong."
"With a guaranteed income, Sordish people will spend as never before. The economy will thrive."
entradas.menu: "With a guaranteed income, Sordish people will spend as never before. The economy will thrive."

entradas.text: "By removing the bureaucracy associated with the welfare system, my plan will save us millions."
entradas.menu: "By removing the bureaucracy associated with the welfare system, my plan will save us millions."

entradas.text: "Yes, and I can't wait to unveil them."
entradas.menu: "Yes, and I can't wait to unveil them."

entradas.text: "Please go on."
"My administration is already providing assistance to unemployed citizens. This is just a logical extension of that policy."
entradas.menu: "My administration is already providing assistance to unemployed citizens. This is just a logical extension of that policy."

entradas.text: "My administration is already providing housing assistance to low-income citizens. This is just a logical extension of that policy."

entradas.text: "You're supposed to be my ally, Kesaro."
entradas.menu: "You're supposed to be my ally, Kesaro."

entradas.text: "Well, you didn't run this by me."
"I don't believe a word of it."
"All I have in mind is Sordish people and Sordish people alone."
